note: The errata sheet prints this program with one procedure line: 'Use the procedure on page 72 of Book IV. When pushing pushbutton 6, be sure to hold the pushbutton down long enough for any carry to propagate to the highest stage of the counter.' The two expects are the Book IV p.72 Procedure step 1 and step 2 light readings, which that line incorporates by reference. Each press holds pushbutton 6 until the network settles plus 200 ms before releasing, per the errata's hold instruction, and each release settles plus 200 ms before the lights are read; the page prints no timing. The post-release advance is needed because settle watches lamp classes, not filament temperature: after the count-2 release light 6 sits at dim for about 55 ms as its filament cools and settle returns inside that window. The power-up state is not printed for this procedure and is not asserted. Not asserted: step 3 and the p.72-73 discussion (light 6 changes on every press, light 5 every other, light 4 every fourth; the counter repeats after 7), which need derived per-press states (Step 7). Release steps carry the counter collapse tag. Split from ER-ALTCOUNTER on 2026-10-14: the original fixture keeps the pre-registered W6 30 ms measured control byte-identical (DECISIONS 2026-09-01 counter ruling); this file carries the printed Book IV p.72 readings.

script.cite: errata.pdf p.2 (PDF p.2), right column, 'Program for alternate counter' Procedure, incorporating Book IV printed p.72 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.78, Procedure step 1
script.quote: Use the procedure on page 72 of Book IV. | 1. Turn power ON. Push pushbutton 6 and release. Binary output lights 4, 5 and 6 will read OFF, OFF, ON or 001. The Binary Counter is displaying a 1.

script.cite: errata.pdf p.2 (PDF p.2), right column, 'Program for alternate counter' Procedure, incorporating Book IV printed p.72 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.78, Procedure step 2
script.quote: Use the procedure on page 72 of Book IV. | 2. Push pushbutton 6 again and release. Binary output lights 4, 5 and 6 will now read OFF, ON, OFF or 010. The Binary Counter is now displaying a 2.
